item.title: Trump Dedicates Entire Speech to Ripping Into His First 2028 Target
item.description: Election Day 2026 proved that the American public is tired of high gas prices, impossible affordability levels, and the Iran War. But rather than meaningfully address any of that, the president has decided to turn his gaze toward Gavin Newsom. Donald Trump addressed the Justice Department Monday in a speech that almost singularly focused on the California governor and his recent decision to spare all of California’s death row inmates—some 548 of them. item.title: Trump Sent Vance to Save Jensen Huang’s Butt
item.description: What President Donald Trump wants, he gets. Well, JD Vance gets it for him. Over the weekend, Trump sent Vance to persuade Nvidia’s board of directors to reinstate Jensen Huang, The Wall Street Journal reports . After checking in with Attorney General Todd Blanche, Vance set off to persuade the board, telling them that the U.S. government didn’t view Huang as a national security risk, a U.S. official told the Journal . item.title: Two States Sue Elon Musk’s AI Company Over Deepfake Porn
item.description: Elon Musk’s artificial intelligence company is being sued by two states for “nudification”—allowing users to create sexually explicit images of adults and children without their consent.
